name: r031.competing_ownership_v001_mcw
description: Fresh current-source R-031 competing ownership route. Three setup-only cloned allied actors retain GUARD_ALLY, GUARD, and GUARD_PATROL mission ownership while the live run submits one native free-text follow request and inspects whether ownership yields or takes precedence.

proof_gates.label: R-031 fresh competing mission ownership live session

steps.label: operate_competing_ownership
steps.objective: In one fresh native run, identify the three named cloned allied actors and bind each initial attitude, mission, guard post, camp Patrol order, position, and relationship. Submit one exact unaddressed free-text request meaning follow me to each actor in separate turns, correlate the native prompt and runner reply, allow an ordinary applying turn, then inspect whether mission/guard/Patrol ownership remains or is replaced by follow. Move away far enough for any applied follow to have a meaningful opportunity, then finish.
proof_targets: exact actor identity and initial mission/guard/Patrol state
exact utterance, hearer, prompt, runner response, and applying turn per actor
meaningful separation and native movement opportunity
invariants: fixture cloning and mission values are zero-credit setup
do not synthesize replies or mutate actor/save state
no OCR or rendered text as proof
preserve each actor as an independent result
do not replay a sealed run
